meta.title: Pokrillion – the daily Pokémon trivia
meta.description: 7 prompts. Rare answers score more. New every day.

rules: 7 prompts every day – the same for everyone.
Many answers are correct. The rarer yours, the more points.
25 seconds per prompt. Wrong answers cost 3 seconds.
One answer per prompt counts. The Master Ball answer scores 100.
